name: emperor
trans: n. the male ruler of an empire

name: colonist
trans: n. a person who settles in a new colony or moves into new country

name: the upper class(es)
trans: N. phrase 上流社会

name: royal
trans: adj. of or relating to or indicative of or issued or performed by a king or queen or other monarch; established or chartered or authorized by royalty

name: labor/labour
trans: n. 劳工

name: peasant
trans: n. a country person; one of a (chiefly European) class of agricultural laborers

name: farmer
trans: n. a person who operates a farm

name: slave
trans: n. a person who is owned by someone; someone who works as hard as a slave

name: plantation
trans: n. an estate where cash crops are grown on a large scale (especially in tropical areas)

name: settlement
trans: n. a body of people who settle far from home but maintain ties with their homeland…

name: site
trans: n. the piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located); physical position in relation to the surroundings

name: remains
trans: n. any object that is left unused or still extant

name: monument
trans: n. a structure erected to commemorate persons or events

name: wreck
trans: n. something or someone that has suffered ruin or dilapidation

name: aboriginal
trans: adj. of or pertaining to members of the indigenous people of Australia

name: custom
trans: n. accepted or habitual practice; a specific practice of long standing

name: ritual
trans: n. any customary observance or practice; the prescribed procedure for conducting religious ceremonies

name: artefact/artifact
trans: n. 手工艺品

name: rock art
trans: N. phrase 岩石艺术

name: engraving
trans: n. a print made from an engraving

name: pattern
trans: n. a perceptual structure; a customary way of operation or behavior

name: image
trans: n. an iconic mental representation; (Jungian psychology) a personal facade that one presents to the world

name: figure
trans: n. a diagram or picture illustrating textual material; alternative names for the body of a human being

name: population
trans: n. the people who inhabit a territory or state; a group of organisms of the same species inhabiting a given area

name: trade
trans: n. the commercial exchange (buying and selling on domestic or international markets) of goods and services; the skilled practice of a practical occupation

name: goods
trans: n. benefit; moral excellence or admirableness

name: crops
trans: n. the yield from plants in a single growing season

name: livestock
trans: n. any animals kept for use or profit

name: archaeology
trans: n. the branch of anthropology that studies prehistoric people and their cultures

name: excavation
trans: n. the act of digging

name: technology
trans: n. the practical application of science to commerce or industry

name: compass
trans: n. navigational instrument for finding directions; an area in which something acts or operates or has power or control:

name: map
trans: n. a diagrammatic representation of the earth's surface (or part of it)

name: satellite
trans: n. man-made equipment that orbits around the earth or the moon

name: sensor
trans: n. any device that receives a signal or stimulus (as heat or pressure or light or motion etc.) and responds to it in a distinctive manner

name: sonar
trans: n. a measuring instrument that sends out an acoustic pulse in water and measures distances in terms of the time for the echo of the pulse to return

name: radar
trans: n. measuring instrument in which the echo of a pulse of microwave radiation is used to detect and locate distant objects
